paper_metadata.title: Effects of Al Content on the Microstructure, Mechanical Properties, and Oxidation Behavior of CoCrNiAlxY Middle Entropy Alloys
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Materials Engineering and Performance

evidence.section: Abstract
evidence.quote: CoCrNiAlxY ( x = 0.2, 0.6, 1.0 and 1.4) middle entropy alloys were prepared, and the effects of Al content on the microstructure, mechanical properties and oxidation behavior at 1200 /C176C of CoCrNiAlxY middle entropy alloys were studied.

evidence.section: 3.1 Effect of Al Content on Microstructure of CoCrNiAlxY MEAs
evidence.quote: For CoCrNiAlY and CoCrNiAl1.4Y alloys, duplex phase structure consisting of A2 and B2 can be found, which agrees well with the observations in the (CoCrNi)100-xAlx and AlxCoCrFeNi alloys (Ref 20, 25). The EDS maps in Fig. 3(c) and (d) show that Cr enriches in the A2 phase and B2 phase is enriched with Ni and Al.
